Author: kaldigo
Name: Aetherworks
Description: Teleport home while Return is on cooldown, sync shared hotbars between PvE and PvP, and withdraw saddlebag stacks while leaving one for easy duplicate entrusting. Each feature is independently enabled.
Punchline: Paid Return fallback, shared hotbar sync and saddlebag conveniences.
Changelog: 0.2.1.3: Fix Withdraw all but one doing nothing: use the saddlebag's Remove from Saddlebag action and How many do you want to remove? prompt, rather than retainer Retrieve Quantity/withdraw labels. Allow the original context menu time to close. Report unavailable native actions and unexpected quantity dialogs in chat instead of failing silently. Native in-game acceptance remains pending.
